title: Clawd X Digest
summary: AI & Agentic Loops: Andrew Ng highlights the transition to self-improving loops within 3-6 months, while developers compile E-Fund manager Zheng Xi's investment framework into a Claude Code Skill.

Workflow Shifts: Viral guides detail how developers use Claude Code inside Obsidian to construct a self-compounding 'second brain' wiki, and Boris Cherny explains how he ditched IDEs to code on his phone.
AI Research Milestones: OpenAI's o3 Deep Research successfully helps clinicians solve complex rare pediatric disease cases in a newly published NEJM AI study.

World Cup Legacy & Action: Debates intensify around Messi's World Cup legacy compared to Pelé, while Messi's relentless counter-attack performance at 39 and Mbappé's pitch management capture viral attention.

items.title: @ridark_eth: Andrej Karpathy's Second Brain System
items.body: A breakdown of a viral workflow inspired by Andrej Karpathy: using AI agents to build a self-compounding personal knowledge wiki instead of just using it to write code. Users point tools like Claude Code to an Obsidian vault to automatically ingest resources and maintain a structured wiki.

items.title: @0xMovez: Andrew Ng on the Shift to Agentic Loops
items.body: AI pioneer Andrew Ng states that 100% of his tasks are now done by AI agents, and notes that self-improving loops represent the next big shift. He predicts that everyone will transition to these loops in the next 3 to 6 months, rendering basic prompting obsolete.

items.title: @Raytar: How the Anthropic Team Uses Claude
items.body: Insights from a presentation by Boris Cherny on how the Anthropic team utilizes Claude internally. Cherny revealed he deleted his local IDE eight months ago and now codes primarily using Claude directly from his phone, highlighting a shift in software engineering workflows.

items.title: @alisawuffles: OpenAI Career Transition Insights
items.body: Alisa Liu announces she is joining OpenAI and publishes a detailed guide detailing her challenging but rewarding job search experience, aimed at demystifying the AI industry hiring process for other applicants.

items.title: @OpenAI: o3 Deep Research Solves Rare Disease Cases
items.body: OpenAI publishes a collaborative study in the New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM) AI alongside researchers from Boston Children's Hospital and Harvard. The paper demonstrates how o3 Deep Research assisted clinicians in solving previously unresolved pediatric rare disease cases.

items.title: @markksantos: Fugu Ultra vs. Claude Opus 4.8 Head-to-Head
items.body: A benchmark test comparing Sakana Fugu Ultra and Claude Opus 4.8 on a Three.js Crossy Road game development task. While Opus 4.8 won on final design and application functionality quality, Fugu Ultra demonstrated impressive speed and cost efficiency, running for just $7.32 compared to Opus's $37.85.

items.title: @SUOHA_AI: Quantitative Skill for Fund Manager Zheng Xi
items.body: Community developers have compiled and distilled a decade of public writings, quarterly reports, and interviews from E-Fund manager Zheng Xi into a custom AI投研 skill. The tool is compatible with Claude Code and codeX, allowing users to query, analyze, and map his investment framework against actual holdings.

items.title: @fminvestllc: Evolution of Cash Management via Treasury ETFs
items.body: F/m Investments discusses cash management, emphasizing that tools have evolved past traditional money market funds. They highlight TBIL, which provides short-term Treasury exposure with ETF-level efficiency, liquidity, and transparency.

items.title: @freedomcenterlu: Virginia Supreme Court Redistricting Ruling
items.body: Virginia's Supreme Court upheld the independent redistricting commission created in 2020. In response, local Democrats are debating raising the retirement age for justices to replace those who ruled against them, drawing criticism over judicial independence.

items.title: @jewishinsider: Midterm Campaign Funding Flows
items.body: An investigation by Jewish Insider explores the dark money network behind the Justice Democrats' spending surge in the 2026 midterms, highlighting the political action committees and donors funding primary campaigns.

items.title: @FannieMae: Manufactured Housing and Financing Options
items.body: Fannie Mae shares data showing that manufactured homes provide a high-quality, lower-cost path to homeownership. Some owners save up to 40% on monthly housing costs compared to site-built homes, backed by expanded financing options.

items.title: @NetMentorTW: Messi's Determination at 39 Years Old
items.body: A breakdown of Lionel Messi's sensational second goal. At 39, Messi led a counter-attack from 40 meters, created an opportunity for a teammate who missed, and immediately fought for the rebound to secure the 2-0 victory, highlighting his relentless work ethic.

items.title: @NJanfren: Comparing World Cup Careers of Messi and Pelé
items.body: A heated critique of comparisons between Lionel Messi and Pelé. The post points out that Pelé won three World Cups in four appearances, whereas Messi played five to secure one title and six to surpass Pelé's goal count, arguing Pelé's tournament legacy remains unmatched.

items.title: @mui_king: 2026 World Cup Goal Standings
items.body: An analysis of the current World Cup goalscorer standings, noting that Messi's five goals place him seventh in the tournament rankings. Germany leads with nine goals, followed by the Netherlands and Canada with seven.

items.title: @NoodleHairCR7: Kylian Mbappé Takes Charge of Pitch Conditions
items.body: Fans react with amusement as Kylian Mbappé is spotted directing stadium cleaners to remove excess water from specific areas of the pitch, showcasing his hands-on leadership style during a waterlogged World Cup match.

items.title: @njdmarlon: Norway's Viking Row World Cup Moment
items.body: Norway U15 teammate history and senior team achievements culminate in a spectacular post-match celebration, with the Norwegian national team performing a massive 'Viking Row' celebration alongside their traveling fans.
